what: simd-lexer: the parser lexes with ra-ap-rustc_lexer 0.166 (via the converter), not the pinned nightly lexer in crates/rustc_lexer (nightly-2026-10-27, 16d1ffac). The two differ only in k#ident (ForcedKeywordIdent, unstable, nightly lexes `k#foo` as one token). The SIMD lexer keeps today's behavior exactly (k# goes to the reference path, differential tests are against ra-ap 0.166). Decide whether parser should switch to crates/rustc_lexer (superset-of-rust says the pinned nightly is the reference); if so, the lane switching it updates lexed_str.rs extend_token for ForcedKeywordIdent and simd-lexer's differential tests follow the same reference automatically.
